title: BRCA Variations Risk Assessment in Breast Cancers Using Different Artificial Intelligence Models.
authors: Senturk, Niyazi; Tuncel, Gulten; Dogan, Berkcan; Aliyeva, Lamiya; Dundar, Mehmet Sait; Ozemri Sag, Sebnem; Mocan, Gamze; Temel, Sehime Gulsun; Dundar, Munis; Ergoren, Mahmut Cerkez
one_liner_zh: 该研究用模糊推理和神经网络对乳腺癌BRCA基因变异进行风险评估，属于临床表型预测，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Artificial intelligence provides modelling on machines by simulating the human brain using learning and decision-making abilities. Early diagnosis is highly effective in reducing mortality in cancer. This study aimed to combine cancer-associated risk factors including genetic variations and design an artificial intelligence system for risk assessment. Data from a total of 268 breast cancer patients have been analysed for 16 different risk factors including genetic variant classifications. In total, 61 BRCA1, 128 BRCA2 and 11 both BRCA1 and BRCA2 genes associated breast cancer patients' data were used to train the system using Mamdani's Fuzzy Inference Method and Feed-Forward Neural Network Method as the model softwares on MATLAB. Sixteen different tests were performed on twelve different subjects who had not been introduced to the system before. The rates for neural network were 99.9% for training success, 99.6% for validation success and 99.7% for test success. Despite neural network's overall success was slightly higher than fuzzy logic accuracy, the results from developed systems were similar (99.9% and 95.5%, respectively). The developed models make predictions from a wider perspective using more risk factors including genetic variation data compared with similar studies in the literature. Overall, this artificial intelligence models present promising results for BRCA variations' risk assessment in breast cancers as well as a unique tool for personalized medicine software.
abstract_zh: 人工智能通过模拟人脑的学习和决策能力，在机器上提供建模。早期诊断在降低癌症死亡率方面非常有效。本研究旨在结合包括遗传变异在内的癌症相关风险因素，设计一个人工智能系统用于风险评估。共分析了268名乳腺癌患者的数据，涉及16种不同的风险因素，包括遗传变异分类。总计使用了61名BRCA1、128名BRCA2和11名同时携带BRCA1和BRCA2基因相关的乳腺癌患者数据，利用Mamdani模糊推理方法和前馈神经网络方法作为MATLAB上的模型软件来训练系统。对12名此前未接触过该系统的受试者进行了16项不同的测试。神经网络的训练成功率为99.9%，验证成功率为99.6%，测试成功率为99.7%。尽管神经网络的整体成功率略高于模糊逻辑的准确性，但开发系统的结果相似（分别为99.9%和95.5%）。与文献中的类似研究相比，开发的模型利用包括遗传变异数据在内的更多风险因素，从更广泛的视角进行预测。总体而言，这些人工智能模型为乳腺癌中BRCA变异的风险评估提供了有前景的结果，并成为个性化医疗软件的独特工具。
